predecessors.name: Allied-occupied Germany
predecessors.text: the three Western occupation zones, merged ("Bizonia", then "Trizonia") without the Saar and without West Berlin

successors.name: Germany (reunified)
successors.text: West Germany (the whole FRG shape) enlarged by the five East German states and Berlin

ledger.x: 1949: the Federal Republic of Germany is founded in the three Western zones, with Bonn as provisional seat.
1957: the Saarland becomes a state of West Germany.
1990: the Federal Republic absorbs the German Democratic Republic on 3 October.
1990: West Germany ends at reunification on 3 October; the state itself continues as the enlarged Federal Republic.

certainty.note: The outline follows zone and state lines fixed in 1945-49 and the inner German border (1,381 km, Inner German border page opened for the GDR dossier); the Saarland boundary became German on 1 January 1957.
